checks: All five students completed all 60 official answers.
Every featured role has strong full-profile alignment and support from at least three follow-up questions.
Changing all self-reported skills to new does not change interest scores or featured careers.
Mixed student retains identical six scores through design and technology branches.
All-unsure control yields no featured career.
findings: Three-card display fills weaker exploration slots even when no additional field is endorsed.
Broad interest support can remain positive for engineering despite directly disliked field-work questions.
Medical follow-ups map diagnosis answers jointly to NP, physician and PA, so those choices do not uniquely establish which profession is preferred.
Dental treatment-planning option is mapped to dentist, hygienist and assistant; responsibilities need finer distinction.
